title: 第21章 这修炼体系一看就没前途第22章 隐雾谷
content_zh:
[获得【法钱】x36]
[获得【回气丹】x5]
【烈火弓】
【介绍：上品法器，弓身由百年火梧桐锻造，弓弦以主修《万象宝身诀》的修士大筋鞣制，铭刻“聚火”、“疾风”符文。
无需箭矢，拉弦即可凝聚火行灵炁为矢，射程远，穿透力强，对阴邪秽物有额外克制。非专修火行或真炁雄厚者难以发挥全部威力。】
楚墨利落的拾起所有光球，又俯身将刘虎搜刮干净，才心情愉悦地收起战利品。
不知对方背了多少贷款，费尽心力，才弄到这柄上品法器，最终却便宜了自己。
“啧啧。”
随手弹出一道低阶火符，将尸体烧成烟灰，他自语道：“杀人放火金腰带，古人诚不欺我。”
既然解决敌人，楚墨不再停留，转身就沿着原路疾驰。刘豹和刘浪手中的法器也不错，不能暴殄天物。
与此同时，另一边。
“轰咔——！”
一道闪电凭空出现，携带雷霆万钧之势，劈向措不及防的刘豹。他身上的护身灵光应声而裂，惨白电光映出其眼中的惊恐，“不——”
惨叫声戛然而止，恐怖的雷符贯穿天灵，在其脆弱的肉身内疯狂肆虐。顷刻间，原地只留下一具碳化的尸骸。
赢乐望着失去声息的刘豹，露出畅快笑容：“还敢追你爷爷我，不知道我不缺上品灵符的吗？”
他喘了几口粗气，平复翻涌的气血，目光落在那柄上品灵伞上，顿时变得灼热。
这时，朱鸣也握着羽扇，略显踉跄地走近，“此番真是危险，刘家兄弟竟有两件上品法器......多亏赢师弟底牌雄厚，我等才逃得一命。”
在修为相若的情况下，法器品质往往能主导战局。
他与赢乐的法器只是中品，若非刘豹大意轻敌，未能料到赢乐还有底牌，恐怕二人早已魂归玄幡。
“朱兄客气了，你我同门之间，理当互助。”赢乐摆摆手，脸上适时露出一丝忧色，“只是不知楚兄他们现在如何了……”恐怕已是凶多吉少。

朱鸣见状，不动声色地附和：“可惜你我如今状态，也无力回援，否则......”
“唉，没办法。”赢乐叹了一口气，“我最后一张保命符箓已经用掉，此刻回去也是送死。早知道，就该多备几张的。”
闻言，朱鸣眼中闪过一丝异色，他余光瞥过地上的灵伞，语气如常地安慰：
“师弟不必自责，相信他们吉人自有——”
话音未落，异变突生。
一道无形风刃自羽扇中挥出，直取毫无防备的赢乐。
‘对不住了师弟，要怪就怪你身家太厚，如今还多了这把上品法器，实是在惹人垂涎。’朱鸣眸中浮现出贪婪之色。
眼见风刃逼近，偷袭即将成功。
“早就等着你了！”
赢乐突然身形一扭，诡异地避开了那无形风刃，同时手中不知何时已扣住了一张赤色灵符！
“轰咔——！”
又一道刺目雷光，以迅雷不及掩耳之势，反劈向满脸错愕，根本来不及做出任何反应的朱鸣。
“你明明说没...”朱鸣的惊骇质问声，被淹没在雷霆之中。
雷光散尽，只见朱鸣浑身焦黑，冒着青烟，直挺挺地倒地，眼中残留着浓浓惊恐，仿佛难以置信般。
content_en:
[Get [Magic Money] x36]
[Obtain [Rejuvenation Pill] x5]
【Fire Bow】
[Introduction: A top-grade magical weapon. The bow body is forged from a century-old fire sycamore. The bow string is tanned by a monk who majored in "The Treasure Body Art of All Things" and is engraved with the runes of "Gathering Fire" and "High Wind".
No arrows are needed, just pulling the string can condense the fire energy into arrows. It has a long range, strong penetrating power, and has extra restraint against evil and evil objects. Those who do not specialize in Fire Elements or have strong True Qi will be unable to exert their full power. 】
Chu Mo picked up all the light balls neatly, leaned over and searched Liu Hu cleanly, and then put away the loot happily.
I don’t know how many loans the other party took on, and he worked hard to get this high-grade magic weapon, but in the end he got an advantage.
"Tsk, tsk."
A low-level fire talisman popped up casually, burning the corpse into soot. He muttered to himself: "The golden belt of murder and arson, the ancients will not deceive me."
Now that he had dealt with the enemy, Chu Mo no longer stopped, turned around and galloped along the original road. The magical weapons in the hands of Liu Bao and Liu Lang are also good, and they cannot be wasted.
Meanwhile, on the other side.
"Boom--!"
A bolt of lightning appeared out of thin air, carrying the force of thunder, and struck Liu Bao who was caught off guard. The protective spiritual light on his body cracked in response, and the pale electric light reflected the fear in his eyes, "No--"
The screams stopped suddenly, and the terrifying thunder talisman penetrated the Tianling, raging crazily in its fragile body. In an instant, only a carbonized corpse was left on the spot.
Ying Le looked at Liu Bao who had lost his voice and showed a cheerful smile: "You still dare to chase your grandfather and me, don't you know that I don't lack high-grade spiritual talismans?"
He took a few deep breaths to calm down the surging blood, and his eyes fell on the high-grade spiritual umbrella, which suddenly became hot.
At this time, Zhu Ming also held the feather fan and approached slightly staggeringly, "This is really dangerous. The Liu brothers actually have two high-grade magic weapons... Thanks to Junior Brother Ying's strong cards, we escaped with our lives."
When their cultivation levels are similar, the quality of the magic weapon can often dominate the battle situation.
His and Ying Le's magical weapons were only of medium quality. If Liu Bao hadn't underestimated the enemy and failed to realize that Ying Le had a trump card, they might have already returned to Xuan Ban.
"Brother Zhu, you're welcome. You and I, fellow sect members, should help each other." Ying Le waved his hands, a hint of worry appeared on his face at the right time, "I just don't know how Brother Chu and the others are doing now..." I'm afraid the situation is in danger.
Seeing this, Zhu Ming calmly agreed: "It's a pity that you and I are in the current state and can't help you, otherwise..."
"Alas, there is no other way." Ying Le sighed, "My last life-saving talisman has been used, and I will die if I go back now. If I had known better, I should have prepared a few more."
Hearing this, a strange color flashed in Zhu Ming's eyes. He glanced at the spiritual umbrella on the ground out of the corner of his eye, and said in a comforting tone as usual:
"Junior brother, there is no need to blame yourself. I believe they are good friends of their own accord——"
Before he finished speaking, a sudden change occurred.
An invisible wind blade swung out from the feather fan, directly striking the unsuspecting Ying Le.
‘I’m sorry, junior brother, if I want to blame you, it’s because you are too rich. Now you have this high-grade magic weapon, which is really coveted. ’ A look of greed appeared in Zhu Ming’s eyes.
Seeing the wind blade approaching, the sneak attack is about to succeed.
"I've been waiting for you!"
Ying Le suddenly twisted his body and strangely avoided the invisible wind blade. At the same time, he didn't know when he had a red talisman in his hand!
"Boom--!"
Another dazzling bolt of lightning struck Zhu Ming, who had a look of astonishment on his face, with lightning speed, and had no time to react.
"Did you clearly say..." Zhu Ming's horrified question was drowned in the thunder.
When the thunder light dissipated, Zhu Ming was seen covered in black smoke and falling straight to the ground, with a look of deep horror in his eyes, as if he couldn't believe it.
